name: bodily fluid homunculus

phase_0.boundary_condition: The hermetic seal of the alchemical glass flask, acting as the bounded womb of the art

VINIT.justification: The unformed, inert prima materia before the alchemical work begins

TANCH.justification: The sealed boundary and womb that contains the entire operation and prevents the escape of the volatile spirit

AFWD.justification: The forward morphism of ascent, where the volatile spirit rises as a vapor

AREV.justification: The reverse morphism of descent, where the heavy matter decays and blackens

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of distillation cycles that feeds and builds the nascent form

IMSCRIB.justification: The entity that recognizes itself, achieving identity and consciousness within the vessel

FSPLIT.justification: The alchemical solve that branches the unified matter into subtle spirit and gross body

FFUSE.justification: The alchemical coagula that recombines the separated branches into the living homunculus

EVALT.justification: The affirmative state where the ascending spirit is purified and ready for animation

EVALF.justification: The negative state where the gross matter putrefies into irrecoverable decay

ENGAGR.justification: A paradice where the pure spirit and rotting body are held simultaneously in the vessel without resolution

IFIX.justification: The permanent, irreversible seal inscribed on the glass to fix the homunculus's existence

phase_2.split_input: the prepared alchemical matter (the unified potential of the homunculus)
phase_2.fuse_result: the unified living homunculus (the actualized prepared matter)

phase_3.void_description: inert, unformed bodily fluid before the alchemical work begins
phase_3.true_description: the animated, conscious homunculus, fully realized and alive
phase_3.false_description: the putrefied, rotting mass, failed to achieve animation
phase_3.both_description: the liminal homunculus, a paradice of living spirit trapped in dead, unresponsive matter

steps.domain_action: Introduce the raw bodily fluid as the unformed prima materia
Seal the fluid within the hermetic glass vessel, establishing the boundary of the womb
Apply heat to separate the subtle spirit from the gross body
The subtle spirit sublimates and rises as a volatile vapor (T-arm)
The spirit achieves volatile purity and readiness for animation (T-arm)
The gross body undergoes putrefaction and blackening, descending into decay (F-arm)
The body decays into foul, irrecoverable rot (F-arm)
The spirit and body are held in suspension, a paradice of separated states within the vessel
Cool the vessel to force the conjunction of the subtle spirit and gross body
Circulate the recombined humors, feeding the nascent form through repeated distillation
The homunculus recognizes itself, achieving self-awareness and identity
Inscribe the binding sigil on the vessel, permanently recording and containing the homunculus

phase_5.compiler_frontend: the alchemical operator's will and ritual instructions
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: the circulation of humors and vapors within the sealed vessel
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the accumulated layers of distillation and the genetic memory of the bodily fluid
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the planetary hours and the cyclical application of heat and cooling
phase_5.alfs_store: the ancient grimoires and alchemical treatises (e.g., Paracelsus, pseudo-Aristotle)

phase_6.cycle_cost: the operator's vital energy and the fuel for the alchemical fire
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: the sealed vessel containing the separated spirit and putrefying body
phase_6.post_cycle_state: the sealed vessel containing the recombined, animated homunculus
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the system is closed and hermetic; the entropy of putrefaction is perfectly balanced by the negentropic order of spiritual conjunction
